sara: Quick check: partner asked for a last-minute marketplace tile tweak and wants the joint blog pushed at the same time. Can we still hit Friday 9am PT?
omar: I can fast-track the blog but need final partner quote + legal sign-off by Thu EOD.
tina: Design: I can update the tile but need exact logo SVG and primary product screenshot. Will aim for Thu afternoon.
kevin: Eng: were green on the staging flow but need partner test creds to validate install path. Share partner_id and token.
sara: Partner ops just DMd me partner_id = PART-990. Omar, can you nudge legal?
omar: Nudge out. If legal OK by Thu 5pm we can do a Fri 9am publish. Otherwise must delay 24-48h.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: perform staging publish dry-run at 2056789400 (Thu 16:30 PT).
tina: Small note: hero GIF should be max 4s to keep page weight down. Also need alt text for accessibility.
kevin: Once tokens arrive Ill run smoke: curl POST to /v1/install -> expect 200 + {"installed":true}. Will report results here.
sara: Great. Action items: Omar = legal + blog copy, Tina = tile + gif + alt text, Kevin = smoke test once creds shared, Sara = confirm final publish window with partner. Ping when done. :white_check_mark:
